whatTheTwoNewLinesMean.blowsToFellARaider: an exact count. Every `combat_attack` the journal carries is one blow by one defender, and the killing blow is written as `combat_raider_downed` and added back by hand, because it overwrites the `combat_attack` of the same tick.
whatTheTwoNewLinesMean.ticksARaiderStoodUnderFire: ticks between the first blow a raider took and the tick it went down. Larger than the blow count whenever the domain loses contact and finds it again.
whatTheTwoNewLinesMean.hitTicksToFellADefender: ticks in which a defender's health fell, from the first to the one that put it down. It is deliberately not called a blow count: `ActRaiders` writes nothing in the journal for an ordinary blow, and two raiders reaching one defender on one tick are one hit tick.
whatTheTwoNewLinesMean.waveSpan: ticks from a wave's arrival to its own EndTick. It includes the walk from the gate, so it moves less than the two counts above.
whatTheTwoNewLinesMean.damageProfile: `m<might>r<readiness>`. A defender's blow is a function of might, readiness and the jitter, and the first two are published in the snapshot — so two blows sharing a profile share every term but the jitter, and a profile carrying more than one damage value is the spread being observable.

perRun.note: falls before a wave ever lands, so it contributes nothing to any of these means and is listed to say so

pooled.howItIsPooled: over the 43 raiders and 25 defenders that actually fell in the six runs that reach a wave, not as a mean of six means

whatTheseNumbersAlreadySay.theFightIsShort: seven blows fell a raider and six hit ticks fell a defender. RaiderHp is 30 and a blow is about four, which is the whole arithmetic of it.
whatTheseNumbersAlreadySay.theSpreadExistsAndIsTooSmallToMatter: 8 to 19 profiles a run already carry more than one damage value, so the mechanism of scope item 2 of #336 is alive — #361 made the roll advance per blow. But the amplitude is ±1 on a mean of 4.13, so a profile spans two or three values and the outcome of an exchange still reads off the first blow. What is left of that item is the amplitude, not the source.
whatTheseNumbersAlreadySay.hungerBarelyReachesTheBlow: readiness enters a defender's blow as readiness/25, so the whole 0..100 range of readiness is worth 0..4 damage and the whole 0..100 range of satiety — which is half of readiness — is worth 0..2. Integer division then eats most of it: satiety 20 and satiety 40 give the same damage on the same creature. That is the lever this slice has to make load-bearing, because it is the only one hunger has left after the mod guard.
whatTheseNumbersAlreadySay.theHoldThresholdCannotFire: a wave spans 52 ticks and SatietyDecayPeriod is 5, so a fighter loses about ten points of satiety across a whole wave. CombatJoinSatiety is 25 and CombatHoldSatiety is 20: five points of band against ten points of decay is reachable in principle and was never reached in practice, because nobody stands in the line for the whole span — longestSpellInTheLine is 25..43.
